title: Verify my identity

lead.resident: Optional. Verify once with your ID card and a selfie.
lead.prospect: Verify once. Owners see “Identity verified” on your enquiries.

card.title: Photograph your ID card
card.body: On the licensed provider’s page, about 5 minutes.

selfie.title: Take a selfie
selfie.body: To confirm the card is yours.

privacy: We keep only the outcome — never your ID number, card photo or date of birth.
